watch.summary: After giving up back-to-back goals in Rocket League, the creator copes by enthusiastically fake-cheering for his opponent's skill.

beats.what: Creator expresses disbelief after letting his opponent score.
Creator calls his own play unacceptable as the goal replay finishes.
Creator predicts the opponent will score a beautiful kickoff goal.
Opponent scores directly off the kickoff.
Creator screams overly enthusiastic sarcastic praise at his opponent.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'm so happy for you man, nice shot!
watch.why: The creator's ironic pivot into extreme supportive cheerleading after getting styled on creates great comedic contrast. His sarcastic prediction coming true immediately sets up the unhinged supportive reaction.
